title: Credits Tick Down (Seventy Two Hundred)
style: synthwave, retro 80s, male lead vocal, female robotic harmony, 110 BPM, gated drums, arpeggiated bass, neon, cinematic, count-down, meter-spinning, late-night-studio, productive
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Seventy two hundred credits sitting in the bank
Every batch a fifty drop, the master keeps the rank
Ten credits per track, two versions in the box
The number ticks down slow, the engine never stops

[Pre-Chorus]
Watch the meter spinning, watch the counter drop
Every click another fifty, the agent doesn't stop

[Chorus]
Credits tick down, credits tick down
Seven thousand left to fund the master's crown
Credits tick down, credits tick down
The Suno meter spinning while the catalog grows round

[Verse 2]
Started near eight thousand, now we're under seven five
Every batch a hundred versions keeping the catalog alive
SongPals account riding, every drop a little song
The library's a thousand and the queue keeps coming strong

[Bridge]
The master could pause, but the master never breaks
The master sees the long game, every spin he takes
The credits are the fuel and the fuel is just the means
The catalog is the empire, the empire is the dreams

[Outro]
Credits tick down, the meter never stops
The master keeps on shipping till the very last drop
